blocks.text: Phospholipids plasma membranes banane mein aham structural kirdar ada karte hain. Chemically yeh phosphatidic acid se bante (derivatives) hain. Phosphatidic acid ek glycerol, do fatty acids aur ek phosphoric acid (phosphate) se bana hota hai. Jab koi nitrogenous base, jaise choline, ethanolamine ya serine, is ke phosphoric acid se jur jata hai to phospholipid ban jata hai. Aam misalein: phosphatidyl choline (lecithin), phosphatidyl ethanolamine aur phosphatidyl serine. Phosphatidyl choline (Figure 4.35) plasma membranes mein lipid bilayer (dohri teh) banata hai.

blocks.alt: Upar: chaar ajza formulas ke saath: Glycerol, Fatty acid, Phosphate, Nitrogenous base (Choline). Beech: phospholipid, ek hydrophilic sar (head) aur do hydrophobic dumein (tails). Neeche: poora molecule: choline - phosphate - glycerol, jis par do fatty acids; brackets Phosphatidic acid aur Phosphatidyl choline.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.35: Phosphatidyl choline, ek phospholipid (kitab ki Figure 4.35 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Phospholipid molecule ke do hisse hain: head (sar) aur tail (dum). Head polar hai (pani ko pasand karta hai) aur is mein nitrogenous base aur phosphate group hota hai; tail non-polar hai (pani se door rehti hai) aur is mein do fatty acids hote hain.
